review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐲𝐨𝐮'𝐥𝐥 𝐝𝐨 • Supervise DC and AC cable installation, routing and termination across the plant • Oversee the installation and connection of combiner boxes, inverters and associated electrical equipment • Ensure all electrical works comply with approved drawings, specifications and international standards • Conduct and witness electrical testing and pre-commissioning activities, including insulation resistance testing (Megger) and IV curve tracing • Review test results, identify defects and follow up on corrective actions until closure • Coordinate with the Construction Manager, Technical Office, QA/QC and subcontractors to maintain daily progress and resolve site issues • Prepare inspection requests, test reports and as-built documentation, and support Consultant and Owner inspections • Monitor installed quantities and progress, and report daily and weekly status to site management •
